svg.title: OAS opening candidate dimension meanings
svg.desc: Source wall layers and hypothetical frame/clearance comparisons. No fabrication, threshold or performance selection.
svg.text: OAS / opening dimensions and mounting trial
Schematic candidate study. Dimensions in mm. Current apertures and finished faces remain unchanged.
Nominal inner-leaf overlap 97.5; room-side reveal 57.5. Neither proves support, fixing or thermal closure.
Gross / frame / practical passage are different
Window B1000, trial g15 → outside frame 970
g is an actual installation/adjustment input. The displayed values are sensitivity points, never order sizes.
Stops, leaf thickness, hinges and angle may reduce practical passage further. No access/escape class is asserted.
Threshold levels, drainage/overflow, structural heads, frame products and boundary performance remain explicit design obligations.
